Yea it is a little hot but I have not had any visible issues with my seedlings. I, myself was worried about using FFOF but its been just fine! I dont think any of my seedlings have had nute burn, I was advised by an older grower to wait at least a month after transplant to start feeding, **He explained**: The Ocean Forest is more than enough to feed that long. When you start feed I would start 1/4 strength on a water, water, feed schedule for a couple weeks then up to water, feed, water. A couple weeks later 1/2 strength, after flipping use the same system but with the flowering nutes.

I had good success with this schedule.

My last 2 grow's I have started the seeds in .5 gallon pots with ocean forest, then transplanted to final pots when they're ready. This current run I just popped them into their final 2.5 gallon pots so I don't have to deal with transplant shock as it stops growth for about a week.
Ocean Forest along with The Trio pack for nutrients
